cueCard.topic: Describe a place where you go to keep fit.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you choose this place to keep fit.

questions.text: Describe a place where you go to keep fit.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a place where you go to keep fit. You should say: where it is; how often you go there; what you do there; and explain why you choose this place to keep fit.

questions.text: Do you usually go there with friends or alone?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you usually go there with friends or alone?

questions.text: Why do people today pay more attention to fitness than in the past?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a place where you go to keep fit, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all fitness. Why do people today pay more attention to fitness than in the past?

questions.text: Is it better to exercise in a gym or outdoors?
